title: Unit 29 Consolidation: Museums, Monuments and Memory
goal: I can use the words of provenance research, monument protection and cultural memory.
I can judge from a viewpoint, use participles before a noun, and contrast with *szemben*.
I can give a purpose with *abból a célból, hogy* and measure an effect with a scalar adverb.
